items.title: The Income-tax Act, 2025
items.summary: The Act, which replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961, took effect on 1 April 2026; it introduced a single 'tax year' and cut the number of sections from over 800 to 536.

items.summary: Parliament passed the Anti Paper Leak Bill, 2026 on 30 July 2026, a week after the Prime Minister announced a draft, following the cancellation of a national medical entrance exam over a paper leak.

freedom-history.title: Independence & history
freedom-history.standfirst: How the nation marked its past in 2026, and the elections and census that shaped its present.

items.title: Republic Day 2026
items.summary: The 77th Republic Day parade on Kartavya Path had two chief guests, European Council President António Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, the first time since 2018 that more than one was invited.

sources.label: Wikipedia: Republic Day (India)

items.title: 150 years of Vande Mataram
items.summary: A year-long commemoration of the song's 150 years began on 7 November 2025; in February 2026 the Home Ministry issued rules for singing it, and in May the Cabinet approved an amendment to protect it under the national-honour law.

sources.label: Wikipedia: Vande Mataram

items.title: The 80th Independence Day
items.summary: Independence Day on 15 August 2026 included a performance of Vande Mataram at the Red Fort.

sources.label: Wikipedia: Independence Day (India)
Wikipedia: Vande Mataram

items.title: The census begins
items.summary: The houselisting phase of India's census began on 1 April 2026 with online self-enumeration for the first time; population enumeration, including a caste count, is scheduled for 9 to 28 February 2027.

sources.label: Wikipedia: 2027 Indian census

items.title: Assam votes
items.summary: Assam's 126 seats were contested on 9 April 2026 and counted on 4 May; the NDA won 102, including 82 for the BJP, and the Congress-led alliance won 21.

sources.label: Wikipedia: 2026 Assam Legislative Assembly election

items.title: A constitutional amendment falls short
items.summary: The Delimitation Bill and the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill failed to pass the Lok Sabha on 17 April 2026 for lack of a two-thirds majority.
